wrapper='''

def transform(grid):
    comps = _components(grid)
    bg = grid[0][0]
    totals = {}
    for color, cells in comps:
        totals[color] = totals.get(color, 0) + len(cells)
    if not totals:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target_color = max(totals, key=totals.get)
    markers = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        if color == target_color:
            continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if h<2 or w<2 or len(cells)!=h+w-1:
            continue
        for er in (r0,r1):
            for ec in (c0,c1):
                if ((er,ec) in cells and all((er,x) in cells for x in range(c0,c1+1))
                    and all((y,ec) in cells for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                    markers.append((len(cells),color,er,ec,r0,r1,c0,c1))
                    break
            else: continue
            break
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for size,mcolor,er,ec,r0,r1,c0,c1 in markers:
        candidates=[]
        for color,cells in comps:
            if color!=target_color: continue
            rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
            if size >= 6:
                # Large corner markers address an object beside their vertical arm.
                if max(rs)<r0 or min(rs)>r1: continue
                if ec==c0 and max(cs)>=ec: continue
                if ec==c1 and min(cs)<=ec: continue
            else:
                down=er==r1; right=ec==c1
                if down and min(rs)<er or not down and max(rs)>er: continue
                if right and min(cs)<ec or not right and max(cs)>ec: continue
            dist=min(abs(r-er)+abs(c-ec) for r,c in cells)
            candidates.append((dist,cells))
        if candidates:
            for r,c in min(candidates,key=lambda x:x[0])[1]: out[r][c]=mcolor
    return out
'''
